text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Ines! I've been<n>prepping for today,
so you just go<n>back to the dorm and get ready to
party!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We've got snacks, cake, and even...<n>something that
starts with a P!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Ryan, you didn't, did you? Anything<n>but that!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I got you a present for your<n>birthday!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(...Thank goodness! I was afraid she<n>was going to
say protein powder!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's a set of all my favorite strength<n>training
equipment! Let's feel the<n>burn together!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(I knew it! I bet she has some protein<n>powder
stashed away somewhere<n>too!)
